starveDetailedDesc1: No memory, no gear, no allies.
starveDetailedDesc2: First stone, first axe, first step into the forest. Come back alive - become stronger. Die - lose everything.
starveDetailedQuote1: There is no grind for the sake of grind. Progression is tied to risk: the more dangerous the raid - the greater the reward.
starveDeathDesc: Took gear into the raid - be ready to lose it.
starveDeathQuote: Like in Tarkov: you die - your loot goes to the enemy. No 'save before battle'. No second chances. Just you and your skill.
starveRiskDesc: The tutorial holds your hand, but after 10 minutes you decide: run for gold through bears or return to base.
starveRiskQuote: Want better gear? Go into the hottest spot. Forest, mountain, volcano. Each biome is a step up in difficulty.
starveGeneticsQuote: Every buff comes with a debuff. No OP without consequences.
starveGeneticsDesc: Genetics is a balance game. Balance metabolism like RimWorld, unlocking genes for your playstyle.
starveWorldDesc: Each biome has its own temperature, resources, creatures. Without bear fur you'll freeze in the mountain. Without ice you'll burn in the volcano.
starveWorldQuote: The AI storyteller watches you. It loves surprises: faction caravans, pack hunts, rare plants. It always knows where you are. And always ready to make your day more interesting.
starveIslandDesc: Build walls, set up workbenches, reinforce the foundation. Like in Rust.
starveIslandQuote1: But without neighbors who come at night while you're offline. Each player has their own private island.
starveIslandQuote2: Factions can raid - and they're more dangerous than any player. Plans: clan bases and raids on other islands. For now - defend and build.
starveFactionsDesc: Crab-people pirates, werewolves in bone caves, ancient guardians of the desert, samurai by the volcano. You can trade, befriend, or fight them.
starveFactionsQuote: Each faction has its own currency, resources, components. Want the best gun? Earn reputation through quests, arena battles. Or take it by force.
starvePlayDesc1: PC and phone - in the same lobby. No FPS discounts. No donations or ads. Everything for gameplay. Season pass without deadlines - play at your own pace.
starvePlayDesc2: Log in daily - get currency for skins. Craft on the go, auto-equip, auto-eat, auto-run, auto-jump.
starvePlayQuote: I made the game convenient, but not easy.
starveFeedback: Your feedback shapes the game. Join the community and influence development.
starveDeveloped: Made with ❤️ Neon Shadow - independent developer from Russia
loginDescription:
To fully participate in the community you need a GitHub token.

Required scopes:
• repo – create and edit posts, comments, reactions.
• gist – personal bookmark storage.

If you provide only one of the scopes, the corresponding features will be unavailable. Without a token you can only read content.

🔒 Security: token is stored locally in encrypted form (obfuscated) and sent only to the GitHub API. We do not store it on our servers. You can always revoke the token in your GitHub settings.
